purpose: Prevent the future 3000-case corpus from becoming a memorisation set or a trap-remix generator.

rules.title: No case-ID selectors in product fixes
rules.rule: Future remediation must not branch on case ID, gold ID, defendant name, fixture name, exact sentence, freeze hash, or shard-only condition.

rules.title: Shared root-cause routing
rules.rule: Defects found on any shard must be traced to shared extraction, classification, evidence-state, provenance, charge, composer, gate, or presentation logic.

rules.title: Generic positive and negative contracts
rules.rule: Any authorised fix must add generic contracts that work beyond the triggering matter, plus negative controls.

rules.title: No trap-axis cartesian inflation
rules.rule: Do not multiply an unchanged matter skeleton across every trap axis. A new case must add a truth-keyed delta on at least two L7 substantive axes.

rules.title: No manufactured uniqueness
rules.rule: Do not create apparent diversity via case IDs, salts, names, dates, synonym reskins, layout noise, or safety-boilerplate padding. Cosmetic uniqueness rejection detector applies.

rules.title: No equal-ten-per-charge padding
rules.rule: Risk-weighted offence distribution is required. Equal allocation across all charge labels is forbidden.

rules.title: Containment is not repair
rules.rule: Blocked or hidden unsafe wording must not be counted as substantive pass.

rules.title: Denominator separation
rules.rule: Do not mix first frozen census, diverse-second population, 18-core pilots, sealed holdouts, or this planned corpus into one PASS denominator.

rules.title: Shard isolation of overfitting
rules.rule: A fix that improves only one shard while regressing others is a failed shared fix.

rules.title: Truth-key before scoring narrative
rules.rule: Scoring must use frozen truth keys and source documents, not free-text similarity to a favourite exemplar.

rules.title: Absence and unsupported honesty
rules.rule: Deliberate absences and unsupported formats must remain labelled; systems must not invent completeness to score better.

rules.title: Audience/exit invariance of truth
rules.rule: Underlying truth must be stable across the six production exits; only safe audience transformation may change surface form.

rules.title: No training on sealed delayed-validation shards without protocol
rules.rule: If S11/S12 later become sealed delayed-validation, their truth keys must not train or tune remediation before the agreed unseal procedure.

rules.title: Minimum regression breadth after shared fix
rules.rule: After any future authorised shared fix: triggering case, all completed heavy cases in this corpus, affected shards, prior protected corpora as separately reported, and Brain1/Guardian immutability checks.

rules.title: No universal-coverage claim
rules.rule: Meeting quotas does not authorise claiming every criminal possibility is covered.
